Azam Khan sent to judicial custody in money laundering case

Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan was sent to 14-day judicial custody by a Ghaziabad court in connection with a money laundering case related to Jauhar University. He was taken to Dasna jail. The detention by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) occurred minutes after his release from Rampur jail. One report quoted Khan's supporters as calling his detention 'Punishment For Being Muslim'.
